first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An airborne person wearing a form-fitting red-and-blue outfit with the head covered, who first extends the legs and then bends the knees and curls up over the continuous sequence.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: The background of gray clouds visible above the buildings and between the upper portions of the buildings.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: A collection of brown, reddish-brown, gray, and glass buildings on both sides of the road and in the distance.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: The gray road and intersection extending from the lower part of the image into the depth between the buildings.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of green and yellow-green tree canopies distributed on both sides of the road and between the buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: A collection of multiple yellow, light-colored, and dark-colored background vehicles on the City street.

entities.name: Thin line pulled by the person
entities.identification: A thin, narrow linear object extending from near Person A toward the sky, with no material, off-screen anchor point, or continuous hand connection specified.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: A collection of horizontal graphic billboards on building exterior walls, including a yellow and blue-purple billboard and a purple-red billboard.
